			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m197_debt_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 197 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m197_debt_consumer_contract value = 197 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m197_debt_due_cycle value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ add = 1 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m197_debt_open value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m197_debt_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m197_debt_escalation_count value = 0 }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_policy_debt add = 1 }
			trigger_event = { id = zg361ip.7197 days = 365 }
		}
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_score_delta add = var:zg361_ip_m197_result_score }
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_evidence_n add = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_last_consumer value = 197 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_ip_m197_business_object_created = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m197_timeline_revision_used value = var:zg361_ip_m201_timeline_revision }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m197_credit_check value = { value = var:zg361_ip_m197_command_credit add = var:zg361_ip_m197_responder_credit } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m197_credit_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_ip_m197_credit_check = 100 } set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m197_credit_conserved value = 1 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m197_consumer_allocate_incident_credit value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m197_object_consumed value = 1 }
				}
				else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m197_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m197_done_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m197_done_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m197_done_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m197_done_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m197_done_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			}
		}
	}
}

zg361_ip_m198_apply_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_choice value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_case_x_owner = { has_variable = zg361_mechanism_198_choice } }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_x_owner.var:zg361_mechanism_198_choice = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_choice value = 2 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_x_owner.var:zg361_mechanism_198_choice = 3 } set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_choice value = 3 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_case_x_owner = { is_ai = yes is_at_war = yes } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_choice value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_case_x_owner = { is_ai = yes stewardship < 10 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_choice value = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:zg361_ip_m198_choice < 3
			NOT = {
trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_ip_m197_business_object_created
				has_variable = zg361_ip_m197_object_type_code
				has_variable = zg361_ip_m197_object_incident_credit_split
				has_variable = zg361_ip_m197_object_owner
				has_variable = zg361_ip_m197_object_subject
				has_variable = zg361_ip_m197_object_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_ip_m197_object_case
				has_variable = zg361_ip_m197_object_state
				has_variable = zg361_ip_m197_consumer_contract
				has_variable = zg361_ip_m197_object_consumed
				has_variable = zg361_ip_m197_consumer_allocate_incident_credit
			}
			var:zg361_ip_m197_business_object_created = 1
			var:zg361_ip_m197_object_type_code = 197
			var:zg361_ip_m197_object_incident_credit_split = 1
			var:zg361_ip_m197_object_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
			var:zg361_ip_m197_object_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			var:zg361_ip_m197_object_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			var:zg361_ip_m197_object_case = $TICKET_CASE$
			var:zg361_ip_m197_object_state = 3
			var:zg361_ip_m197_consumer_contract = 197
			var:zg361_ip_m197_object_consumed = 1
			var:zg361_ip_m197_consumer_allocate_incident_credit = 1
		}
		trigger_else = { always = no }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_choice value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_prerequisite_deferred value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
has_variable = zg361_ip_incident_active
			has_variable = zg361_ip_incident_owner
			has_variable = zg361_ip_incident_subject
			has_variable = zg361_ip_incident_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_ip_incident_serial
			has_variable = zg361_ip_incident_source_kind
			has_variable = zg361_ip_incident_consequence_kind
			has_variable = zg361_ip_x_input_owner
			has_variable = zg361_ip_x_input_subject
			has_variable = zg361_ip_x_input_cycle
			has_variable = zg361_ip_x_input_incident_serial
			has_variable = zg361_ip_x_input_source_kind
			has_variable = zg361_ip_x_input_consequence_kind
			var:zg361_ip_incident_active = 1
			var:zg361_ip_incident_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
			var:zg361_ip_incident_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			var:zg361_ip_incident_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			var:zg361_ip_incident_source_kind > 0
			var:zg361_ip_incident_consequence_kind > 0
			var:zg361_ip_x_input_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
			var:zg361_ip_x_input_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			var:zg361_ip_x_input_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			var:zg361_ip_x_input_incident_serial = var:zg361_ip_incident_serial
			var:zg361_ip_x_input_source_kind = var:zg361_ip_incident_source_kind
			var:zg361_ip_x_input_consequence_kind = var:zg361_ip_incident_consequence_kind
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = zg361_ip_m198_done_owner has_variable = zg361_ip_m198_done_subject has_variable = zg361_ip_m198_done_cycle has_variable = zg361_ip_m198_done_case has_variable = zg361_ip_m198_done_state }
				OR = {
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m198_done_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m198_done_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m198_done_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m198_done_case = $TICKET_CASE$ }
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m198_done_state = $TICKET_STATE$ }
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_x_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_x_subject
			CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_x_cycle_serial
			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_x_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_x_state
			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_x_revision
			ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_x_active
			TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_x_timeline_serial
			FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_x_feedback_revision
			LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_x_last_operation
			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_x_last_choice
			RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_ip_m198_receipt_owner
			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_ip_m198_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_ip_m198_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_ip_m198_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_ip_m198_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_ip_m198_receipt_choice
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
			CHOICE = var:zg361_ip_m198_choice
			OPERATION_ID = 198
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied }
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_result_score value = 4 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m198_choice = 2 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_result_score value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m198_choice = 3 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_result_score value = -2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_ip_m198_choice < 3 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_root_cause_penalty value = 20 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_normal_failure value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:zg361_ip_m198_choice = 2 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_root_cause_penalty value = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_normal_failure value = 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_business_object_created value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_object_type_code value = 198 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_object_firefighting_credit_netting value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_object_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_object_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_object_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_object_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_object_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_object_incident_serial value = var:zg361_ip_incident_serial }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_object_incident_source_kind value = var:zg361_ip_incident_source_kind }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_object_incident_consequence_kind value = var:zg361_ip_incident_consequence_kind }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_object_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 198 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_consumer_contract value = 198 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_object_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_resource_credit value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_resource_root_cause value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_business_object_created value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_object_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_debt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_debt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_debt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_debt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_debt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_debt_incident_serial value = var:zg361_ip_incident_serial }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_debt_incident_source_kind value = var:zg361_ip_incident_source_kind }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_debt_incident_consequence_kind value = var:zg361_ip_incident_consequence_kind }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_debt_type_code value = 198 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_debt_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 198 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_debt_consumer_contract value = 198 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_debt_due_cycle value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ add = 1 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_debt_open value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_debt_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_debt_escalation_count value = 0 }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_policy_debt add = 1 }
			trigger_event = { id = zg361ip.7198 days = 365 }
		}
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_score_delta add = var:zg361_ip_m198_result_score }
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_evidence_n add = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_last_consumer value = 198 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_ip_m198_business_object_created = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_net_firefighting_credit value = { value = var:zg361_ip_m197_responder_credit subtract = var:zg361_ip_m198_root_cause_penalty max = 0 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_consumer_net_firefighting_credit value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_object_consumed value = 1 }
				}
				else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_done_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_done_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_done_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_done_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m198_done_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			}
		}
	}
